title: Fix usage of GUINT_TO_POINTER and GINT_TO_POINTER
description:
`GUINT_TO_POINTER` and `GINT_TO_POINTER` can only store integers up to 32 bits, since pointers are 32-bit wide on some supported platforms.

Fix improper usages of the macros. In the future we might want a script to check that automatically.

As for the changes, sometimes a simple cast is enough, since the underlining data cannot be greater than 32-bit, while in some cases I implemented a different workaround.

One big thing that's missing is to check the usage of `GUINT_TO_POINTER` vs `GINT_TO_POINTER`. In many instances in the code, the former is used to process signed integers, and vice-versa.
